title: A Formal Treatment of Contextual Effects
venue: Proceedings of the ACM SIGPLAN Symposium on Principles of Programming Languages (POPL)
abstract: We present a novel approach to reasoning about contextual effects in programming languages with algebraic effect handlers.

title: Verified Compilation of Effect Handlers
venue: Proceedings of the ACM SIGPLAN International Conference on Functional Programming (ICFP)
abstract: We present a verified compiler from a language with algebraic effects to a low-level continuation-passing style intermediate representation.
